I split a monolith into services and suddenly "just call a function" became a design decision.

REST, gRPC, GraphQL, events — each optimizes for something different:

• REST — resource-oriented, cache-friendly, great default for public APIs
• gRPC — binary, fast, schema-first — service-to-service
• Events — loose coupling, async by default — but ordering and idempotency matter
• API gateway — one front door for auth, routing, rate limits

Sync vs async isn't a style choice. It's a failure-mode choice.
